title: HarnessNet: Feedback-driven Hierarchical Joint Harness Evolution for Multi-agent Systems
abstract: arXiv:2610.15221v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: AI agents can evolve by using environment feedback to revise their harnesses, the software managing model inputs, tool use, memory, and execution, while keeping foundation models frozen. Existing studies focus on single agents, leaving joint harness evolution in multi-agent systems (MAS) underexplored. A single global optimizer faces growing context and workload as the system scales, while access restrictions may prevent sharing agent internals or system-wide feedback. We propose HarnessNet, a framework for hierarchical harness evolution in MAS. Its basic unit, Agentron, comprises an evolvable forward harness, a foundation model, and a local optimizer that can observe and modify only that harness. Agentrons form a layered graph through which environment feedback propagates backward, with upstream optimizers receiving node-specific feedback from the downstream layer. This decomposes joint harness evolution into smaller, coordinated tasks

translated_title: HarnessNet：面向多智能体系统的反馈驱动分层联合Harness演化
translated_abstract: 人工智能智能体可以通过利用环境反馈来修订其harness（即管理模型输入、工具使用、记忆和执行的软件）而实现演化，同时保持基础模型冻结不变。现有研究集中于单智能体，多智能体系统（MAS）中的联合harness演化尚未得到充分探索。随着系统规模扩大，单一全局优化器面临不断增长的上下文和工作负载，而访问限制可能阻碍智能体内部信息或系统级反馈的共享。我们提出了HarnessNet，一个用于MAS中分层harness演化的框架。其基本单元Agentron由一个可演化的前向harness、一个基础模型和一个只能观察并修改该harness的本地优化器组成。Agentron构成一个分层图，环境反馈通过该图向后传播，上游优化器从下游层接收节点特定的反馈。这将联合harness演化分解为更小的、相互协调的任务。
tldr: 提出HarnessNet框架，通过由Agentron基本单元构成的分层图结构和反向传播的环境反馈，将多智能体系统中的联合harness演化分解为更小且相互协调的本地优化任务。
en_tdlr: Proposes HarnessNet, a framework that decomposes joint harness evolution in multi-agent systems into smaller coordinated local optimization tasks via Agentron units organized in a layered graph with backward-propagating environment feedback.
